name: showreel-c3-price-list

voice.text: These prices are hard to compare. They jump around. Turns out, numbers should line up. Fix one: one right edge. Fix two: digits, all one width. Fix three: dots to each name. Spot the cheapest at once.

caption:
These prices are hard to compare. They jump around. ✂️

1. One right edge. Line every price up on the right, so units sit under units.
2. Same-width digits. Most fonts have tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums in CSS); every digit takes the same width, so columns stay straight.
3. Dots to each name. Leaders carry the eye from the service to its price.

Save this for your next price list, menu or invoice. Do you read a price list name first or price first?

edges_ok.why: the design-tutorial stage (a salon's price list on a wall) fills the frame by design
